}}{{TIDTOC|adapter}} ==Overview== :;Models *[[AsiaRF AP7988-001]] • Wi-Fi 7 BE19000 Router Board *[[AsiaRF AW7256-P01]] • Wi-Fi 7 BE19000 M.2 (Key A/E)/Mini PCIe NIC Module {{See also|MediaTek reference design}} {{#set:Probable Linux driver=mt76}}
===Features=== :;Platform *[[MediaTek]] MT7996AV chipset *32-bit RISC-V MCU for Wi-Fi protocol and Wi-Fi offload *2x PCIe 3.0 Interface (2-lane), Embedded SRAM and ROM *UART interface with hardware ﬂow control
:;WLAN *802.11abgn/ac/ax/be compliant *Frequency band: 2.4GHz -4T4R :-Bandwidth: 20 and 40MHz *Frequency band: 5GHz -4T4R 4ss :-Bandwidth: 20,40,80,160MHz *Frequency band: 6GHz -4T5R 4ss :-Bandwidth: 20,40,80,160,320MHz :-5th antenna for more diversity and :for better 6GHz performance *Tr-Band Triple Concurrent (TBTC) *Zero-Wait DFS without interrupting 4x4 :(prevent client disassociation with 1+3x3 architecture) *MU-MIMO TX and RX, MU-OFDMA TX and RX *STBC, LDPC, TX beamformer and RX beamformee *Greenﬁeld mode, mixed mode, and legacy mode *Security: WFA WPA, WPA2, WPA3 personal, WPS 2.0 *QoS: WFA WMM and WMM-PS
:;Wi-Fi 6/6E and Wi-Fi 7 Operation Modes *Simultaneous Tri-band 4+4+4, 12 spatial streams *Wi-Fi 7: 2.4 (40MHz) +5 (160MHz) +6 (320MHz) = 19Gbps *Wi-Fi 6/6E: 2.4 (40MHz) +5 (160MHz) +6 (160MHz) = 11Gbps
:;Version 2 is coming soon
